summary.text: Ryan Fecteau is a Democratic state representative from Maine and Speaker of the Maine House, representing District 132, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He first served as speaker from 2020 to 2022 and was elected to the post again in December 2024.

paragraphs.text: Fecteau was born in Biddeford, Maine, in 1992 and received a bachelor's degree in political science from The Catholic University of America in 2014.
As of January 2026, he was the senior officer of planning and partnerships at Avesta Housing.
Fecteau was first elected to the Maine House in 2014, representing District 11, and served until he was term limited in 2022.
Ballotpedia reports that during his first tenure as speaker he was the youngest presiding officer in the United States and the first openly gay person elected speaker in the state.
He was elected to the House again in 2024, running unopposed in District 132, and the House elected him speaker in December 2024.
He has chaired the Elections Committee and the Labor, Commerce, Research and Economic Development Committee.
